opportunities.title: Reading Buddies teen volunteer

restrictions: Provider selection and orientation are required; an application is not a confirmed place.

cost.original: A participation-cost or screening-fee exemption was not confirmed.

availability.original: Provider describes ongoing recruitment; placement is not guaranteed.

opportunities.commitmentOriginal: Ten one-hour sessions over ten weeks; weekly schedule agreed with the participant.

roleDetails.description: Help younger children practise reading and literacy through library-based activities.
responsibilities: Support a younger buddy with reading practice.
requirements: Volunteer applicant must be in grades 9–12.
Complete provider orientation before beginning volunteer work.
Arrange a mutually suitable weekly library meeting with the assigned buddy.
Provider asks you to submit only one application.
roleDetails.commitment: Ten weekly sessions lasting one hour each. Planned commitment is not recorded completed time.
roleDetails.selection: Incomplete applications are not considered; submitting an application does not guarantee selection.
roleDetails.costNotes: Costs and any screening expenses remain unconfirmed. This role is not counted as verified free.
roleDetails.applicationInstructions: Provider asks you to submit only one application. Read the provider application conditions and apply directly. Provider follow-up covers orientation and placement.
